findings.title: Hummingbird status notice #515050: Delays submitting batch filings to FinCEN
findings.summary_md: Hummingbird reported that it could not complete batch submissions of BSA reports to FinCEN's BSA E-Filing system, beginning around 17:45 ET on November 18. Its first update said filings prepared in Hummingbird were retained and would be submitted automatically once the connection was restored, and that no filings had been lost. Later updates on November 19 said the connection was still down and that FinCEN had posted a service disruption notice affecting SDTM batch filers while the E-Filing website remained unaffected.

findings.title: CTR Batch Filings Rejected Due to FinCEN Service Disruption
findings.summary_md: CU*SOUTH told credit unions that CTRs batch filed through CBX were being rejected by FinCEN because of a service disruption affecting the BSA E-Filing System. An update on November 20 said CTRs transmitted from November 18 onward should be filed directly through the FinCEN portal, and a November 23 update said those reports were showing as Ready to Transmit in tool #991 Work with CTR Forms. The notice instructed filers who had already filed directly to change the filing type from Amended to Initial and save the form to avoid duplicate filings.

findings.title: FinCEN's Automated Batch-Filing Route Disrupted; Website Offers Alternative
findings.summary_md: JBizNews reported that a disruption affected only batch filers using Secure Direct Transfer Mode, while the BSA E-Filing website remained fully operational for individual and batch reports. The article said the alert was still posted Friday evening and that FinCEN had not stated when the disruption began, what caused it, or when SDTM would return. It also noted that no filing deadline extension had been announced at that point.

findings.title: Order FIN-2026-R002: Temporary, limited exceptive relief for certain Bank Secrecy Act and Corporate Transparency Act submissions
findings.summary_md: FinCEN issued order FIN-2026-R002 on November 24, granting temporary, limited exceptive relief for a service disruption that was hindering filers from meeting reporting obligations. The order moved deadlines for certain BSA reports filed through Secure Data Transfer Mode and for Beneficial Ownership Information Reports or FinCEN ID updates from November 18 through December 29 to December 30. It said the Financial Institutions Hotline was not affected and that filers still had to comply with other BSA obligations, including ongoing monitoring for suspicious transactions.
